g.text: Planit — JavaFX dashboard OR CLI (shared controller/facade)
Supporting services across these use cases:
Gemini: F01-F10 generation/analysis except local FAQ.
Places: F05 provider discovery, F06 research.
Edits, approvals, actuals recording and FAQ are local.
Provider participation is not every action in a label.
See class-04 and SD03/SD08 for API relationships.
No login, roles or separate attendee portal.
Organizer can enter member ideas and ask attendee questions.
Both interfaces expose F01-F10; no concurrent shared-store sessions.
Read-only FAQ and simulations do not save new facts.
F03/F04 require approval if blueprint alternatives exist.
No weather, booking or send/publish integration.
Solid actor associations denote participation, not call order.
No «include»/«extend» asserted for optional provider use or workflow order.
External service participation is summarized in the note to avoid crossing actor lines.
